purpose: Mechanically evaluate the pre-outcome Phase-1 label gate already frozen in the Phase-2 attribution contract. Phase-1 signal-time booleans are the only candidate predictors. Phase-2 contributes only the frozen categorical completed-trade outcome bucket. This stage cannot change a label, inspect a numeric return, select a threshold, combine labels, or replay a strategy.

pre_outcome_authority.policy: This Stage-G freeze only restates the already-frozen gate and adds no outcome-contingent choice.

stage_f_input_contract.binding: Before Stage G can run, one separate immutable authorization must bind the exact Stage-F manifest SHA-256 and the manifest-bound diagnostic and summary SHA-256 values. Unknown or inconsistent identity fails closed. No Stage-F output hash may be filled into this pre-result freeze after outcomes are visible.
prohibited_inputs: security, industry, date or identity crosswalk

denominator_and_support.insufficient_support_policy: A reviewer block with either side below 25 is INELIGIBLE and cannot count as a passing block.

exact_gate_algorithm.rates: For each eligible label and Phase-1 reviewer, derive each endpoint rate directly from integer counts divided by true_n or false_n. Recompute rather than trusting serialized rate columns.
exact_gate_algorithm.strict_direction: GREATER_THAN and LESS_THAN are strict. Equality, missing, nonfinite, inconsistent, or zero-denominator values fail that endpoint.
exact_gate_algorithm.reviewer_block_pass: Support is eligible and both the PROFIT_GE_4PCT direction and SEVERE_LOSS direction pass simultaneously for the same label and reviewer.
exact_gate_algorithm.pooled_calculation: Sum the integer true/false denominators and endpoint numerators across all four frozen Phase-1 reviewer blocks, then recompute pooled rates.
exact_gate_algorithm.pooled_pass: Both endpoint directions must pass simultaneously in the pooled completed-event population.
exact_gate_algorithm.label_gate_pass: At least three of four reviewer blocks pass and the pooled result passes, all in the label's frozen direction.
exact_gate_algorithm.multiplicity_policy: Evaluate the three eligible labels independently as single booleans. Do not compare magnitudes, choose a best label, combine labels, or automatically promote any label. Zero, one, or multiple labels may pass; every pass only authorizes a separate future rule freeze.

required_validation: Exactly six diagnostic rows exist for each of the four Phase-1 reviewers: the three eligible labels, the two pooled-unusable labels, and NONE_CLEAR.
Every diagnostic row's pre_outcome_usage_decision matches the frozen reviewer-drift decision.
For each row, true_n plus false_n equals that reviewer's completed-event count and all endpoint numerators lie within their matching denominator.
The same completed-event count is recovered for all labels within a reviewer block.

The Stage-F summary and manifest assert Phase-1 labels unmodified, post-signal not used as predictor, no numeric return read or aggregated, no security identity read or published, no rule search, no replay, and no post-2020 row read.

outputs.publication: Atomic no-overwrite publication with exact input/output hashes and a second pre-publication input re-verification.

next_action: After Stage F is independently validated and exactly hash-bound, implement one mechanical Stage-G evaluator for this contract. A passing label may only become a data-generated development candidate under a separate frozen rule specification; it is not a strategy and does not authorize later-year access.
